newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: AAA, Thomas Cook form global travel alliance.
newsitem.headline: AAA, Thomas Cook form global travel alliance.

text.p: The American Automobile Association and Thomas Cook, two of the most recognised names in travel, said Monday they will form the world's largest leisure travel alliance.
The global network will join Thomas Cook's 1,800 offices with AAA's 1,000 travel agency locations to serve a combined customer base of more than 54 million leisure travelers.

The alliance, which becomes fully operational Jan. 1, 1997, provides leisure travelers who make international travel arrangements through AAA access to Thomas Cook's worldwide services. AAA will reciprocate services to Thomas Cook customers in the United States.

The network will offer free airline reservation changes, ticket revalidation or rerouting, hotel and car rental reservations, changes to travel arrangements, travel planning and emergency local telephone call assistance.
The alliance will focus aggressively on the development and implementation of new travel-related technology applications and electronic distribution channels.

The first joint technology project will begin in January when AAA joins the Catalist Trading Exchange, an electronic leisure travel booking system developed by Thomas Cook. Catalist allows travel counsellors to electronically create customised vacations for independent or group travel to destinations worldwide.
Future initiatives will include negotiations with multinational suppliers and cooperative ventures in the foreign exchange and publishing arenas.
AAA is a federation of 106 motor clubs providing its 39 million members in the United States and Canada with travel, financial, insurance and automotive-related services.
Thomas Cook employs over 12,000 people who serve about 20 million customers a year in financial services and travel-related businesses.
